attributes.attribute: a quasi-historical king and a great ancestor of Ireland

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Eochaid Mugmedón was a quasi-historical king of Ireland. By the British princess Cairenn he fathered Niall of the Nine Hostages. He stands among the great ancestors of the Irish. Many ruling families traced their blood to him. Koch records an adventure of his sons that runs in the continental manner of romance. The tale shows how far the Irish story spread into other lands.
